full_judgment: 2. The plaint case is that the land of Plot No. 936 of Khatian No. 588, Mouza Baro-Moghbazar, Dhaka measuring.30 acres being Municipal Holding No. 1 and 1-A, Malibagh with entire constructions with fittings and fixtures and trees originally belonged to Dr. Khurshid Haider who got the same by virtue of a deed of sale dated 11-4-63 from M/s Free School Street Property Limited. The plaintiff was the owner of a one-storied building on a plot of land measuring approximately 2615 yards on plot No. 43/5-1 /VI of Pakistan Employees Co-operative Housing Society Ltd. at Karachi. On 20-1-70 the plaintiff entered into an agreement with Dr. Khurshid Haider to exchange her house at Karachi on plot No. 43-5/1A/VI with the house comprising plot No. 936 commonly known as 1, Malibagh, Dhaka belonging to the said Khurshid Haider. The exchange value of the property was settled at Taka. 1,50,000.00 Due to sudden difficulties in formalities of registration of the exchange deed there had been delay in completing the transaction. In the meanwhile both the parties delivered vacant possession of their respective properties to each other. The deed of exchange in respect of the suit property was presented for registration with the District Registrar, Dhaka on 28-4-72 but the same could not be done due to promulgation of President's Order No. 16 of 1972. According to the plaintiff, a group of armed young men took forcible possession of the plaintiff's house at 1, Malibagh on 19-12-71. Subsequent thereto the plaintiff came to know from a news item published in a newspaper that the property has been taken over as an abandoned property. The plaintiff submitted representation for release of her house but without any result. Thereafter the plaintiff filed Writ Petition No. 377 of 1980 challenging the action of the Government in treating the plaintiff's property as an abandoned property. The Rule Nisi was made absolute on 17-7-80 with a direction to release the property to the plaintiff and with a further direction to the District Registrar to register the deed of exchange. In pursuance of the direction of the High Court Division the deed of exchange of the plaintiff was registered on 5-9-80 and symbolic delivery of possession of the property was made to the plaintiff on 22-1-82. In the meanwhile, the plaintiff made a representation to the Joint Secretary, Ministry of Public Works to hand over vacant possession of the present suit property, namely, holding No. 1-A, Malibagh which was under occupation of defendant No. 3 Safiuddin Ahmmed. In the meanwhile the plaintiff received a letter from the authority that in Writ Petition No. 377 of 1980 the High Court Division directed to deliver possession of 1, Maiibagh to the plaintiff and the present suit property was not directed to be delivered to her. According to the plaintiff, the suit property and the property which was earlier delivered are part and parcel of plot No. 936. The plaintiff is the absolute owner of Plot No. 936 over which the houses stand. Defendants have no right, title and interest in the suit property.
